root_cause.text: The IPVS checksum validation functions for TCP, UDP, and SCTP assumed the transport header offset for IPv6 was always 40 bytes (sizeof(struct ipv6hdr)) and used the IPv6 next header field (which may be an extension header type) instead of the actual transport protocol, causing incorrect checksum checks when IPv6 extension headers are present.
root_cause.evidence: The patch removes the direct assignment of `tcphoff = sizeof(struct ipv6hdr)` (and similar for UDP and SCTP) and instead passes the correctly computed offset from callers; it also changes `ipv6_hdr(skb)->nexthdr` to `IPPROTO_TCP` and `IPPROTO_UDP` in the `csum_ipv6_magic` calls, addressing the misuse of the extension header type.
